offering_description.value: Provides independent investment research, ratings, data and analytics on funds, stocks and other securities to individual investors, financial advisors, asset managers and institutions. Also manages investment portfolios for advisors and sells credit ratings and indexes. Delivered mainly through subscription software platforms and data feeds.

primary_products.value: investment research and data subscriptions; wealth and portfolio software platforms; market indexes; credit ratings data

primary_services.value: credit ratings; investment management and advisory; research and consulting; retirement plan advisory
